messages:
ivan: Heads-up — restore for tenant-42 in staging failed with a KMS decrypt error. noticed during a routine restore test.
storage-eng: ugh, error logs?
ivan: paste from agent: ```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
maria: I rotated some service account roles last night as part of the low-risk RBAC cleanup. Could be related.
security-oncall: @maria, which role? Backup uploader or the restore runner?
maria: backup-uploader-role was removed from the temporary list and we replaced it with constricted one: `backup-uploader-staging`. I thought we kept cmk access via grant.
encops-bot: KMS alert: Grant for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/old-backup-uploader expired 2026-03-19T23:59:00Z. Detected missing grant when decrypt attempted.
ivan: that matches. staging restore uses the old principal ARN (we saw it in the agent config). Ops rollout might not have updated the agent identity.
anna: quick mitigation: we can create a short-lived grant for the current role with `aws kms create-grant --key-id KEY_ID --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader-staging --operations Decrypt Encrypt` and re-run restore.
leo: +1. but we should also rotate the agent config to reference the new role to avoid repeated grants.
ops-bot: deploy job #4572 shows change: removed `role/old-backup-uploader` from staging config at 2026-03-19T21:48Z.
security-oncall: two issues here: 1) RBAC change wasn't fully propagated to restore agent identity, 2) audit log gap: I can't find a corresponding iam:UpdateRole or kmm grant revoke entry in CloudTrail between 21:40-22:00 for that principal.
storage-eng: confirms — object-store copy completed but restore decrypt fails, which indicates grant expiry not key misconfiguration.
maria: I just re-created a grant and the restore started successfully in staging. command: ```
aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader-staging --operations Decrypt --name temp-restore-grant
```
ivan: can you paste the grant id? we'll pin it to the incident ticket.
maria: grantId: 9876abcd-4321. Revoke scheduled in 12h.
security-oncall: Good. Next actions: (1) add preflight check in restore runner to `aws kms list-grants --key-id` / or attempt a small `kms:Decrypt` test before heavy restore, (2) add an alert when `kms:Decrypt` AccessDenied occurs pointing to RBAC change runbook, (3) triage audit log gap — ask infra to dump CloudTrail S3 partition and check for missing events.
leo: I'll open a follow-up in eng-infra to scope CloudTrail retention/partitioning — suspicious that events between 21:40-22:00 are absent.
anna: also recommend the backup agent fall back to an explicit re-encrypt flow if it detects a grant mismatch: copy object, re-wrap with a secondary key we control, then decrypt locally. Needs security review.
security-oncall: yeah, fallback only with proper approvals — want to avoid accidental key duplication. add to ticket: sec-review for re-encrypt fallback.
ivan: one more thing: let's add an RBAC rollout checklist item — after any role change that affects encryption, run a `restore smoke` in staging and confirm `kms:Decrypt` succeeds.
maria: noted. I'll update the RBAC playbook and add the smoke test to the deployment pipeline.
encops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-42. Tags: kms, rbac, restore, audit-gap.
ivan: thanks all. I'll mark this resolved in staging once we get infra confirmation on CloudTrail.
storage-eng: follow-up: schedule a 1h postmortem to decide long-term fix (preflight + alerts + playbook update). :calendar:
security-oncall: assigning to @leo and @maria for next steps.
leo: got it, will sync offline and post a short runbook update here.
